name: Rofellos's Emissary Torc
text:
You start the game with 2 less life.
Your maximum hand size is increased by one.
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, if it's your first turn, add {G}.
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, if it's your second turn, add {G}.
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, if it's your third turn, add {G}.
